blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy rains may affect parts of Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, and Quezon on Wednesday, Nov. 25, the state weather bureau reported. In its 8 a.m. thunderstorm advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said moderate to heavy rain showers with lightning and strong winds may affect the following areas within the next two hours: READ: Shear line, amihan, easterlies to bring rains over PH on Nov. 25 Meanwhile, the same weather condition is affecting General Nakar, Quezon, and may persist there within the next two hours.
